identity.title: Expose one coherent proven-decoder Import surface

origin.kind: owner continuation request and current master backlog
origin.summary: The owner authorized the next dependency-ready software slice after PL-0037: expose verified 3D decoders through one truthful operator Import workflow.

state.current_summary: One always-reachable localized Import action now routes C3D through the existing recipe-source path and GLB/STL/LAS/LAZ through a truthful Viewer-only path; all five actual decoder paths, state retention, localized runtime UI, Release build, structure, package, and diff gates pass.

objective.summary: Provide one operator-facing Import action for the verified C3D, GLB, STL, LAS, and LAZ decoders while preserving the distinct C3D recipe-input and Viewer-only mesh/point-cloud contracts.
constraints: Expose only C3D, GLB, STL, LAS, and LAZ; do not advertise general glTF, OBJ, PCD, XYZ, TIFF, RAW, or PLY import.
C3D may update the current recipe source through the existing binding path; GLB, STL, LAS, and LAZ are Viewer-only and must not mutate recipe, source binding, result, Preview, Publish, or Run state.
Loading, cancellation, failure, and replacement must keep the last successfully displayed source until a new decode succeeds.
Reuse the existing decoders, semantic theme, MVVM command routing, and progress surface; add no UI framework or speculative import architecture.
Do not expand this slice into drag-and-drop, decoder additions, physical calibration, maximum-input qualification, or human-owner R0.

criteria.text: One always-reachable localized Shell Import action and file dialog expose exactly C3D, GLB, STL, LAS, and LAZ with truthful format and routing text.
C3D Import retains the existing cancellable progress path and exact current-recipe source binding without invoking Preview, Publish, or Run.
GLB, STL, LAS, and LAZ decode away from the UI thread, expose progress and cancellation, apply only the latest successful request, and retain the prior Viewer source on failure or cancellation.
Viewer-only imports visibly identify the loaded format/file and state that the recipe source is unchanged; recipe, source binding, Preview, Publish, Run, and result state remain unchanged.
Focused import routing, decoder compatibility, cancellation/state-preservation, and no-execution checks pass for all five exposed formats.

Current Release build, structure and diff-hygiene gates plus localized Wide and Compact runtime UI checks pass for normal, hover, pressed, focused, disabled, progress, cancel, long-name, and popup states at available DPI scales.

context.summary: The normal operator dialog accepts only C3D and binds it to the Viewer and current recipe.
C3D and LAS/LAZ already have asynchronous progress/cancellation paths; GLB and STL are verified bounded synchronous decoders currently reached through distributed Viewer paths.

evidence.observation: Actual Release EXE Wide/Compact Korean/English captures show the always-reachable import button, held pointer-down/focus path, disabled import plus visible cancel at 47% progress, complete Viewer-only status text, and the native dialog/open popup with exactly C3D, GLB, STL, LAS, and LAZ entries on the selected left monitor at available 125% DPI.

The actual Release EXE loaded a D-backed synthetic 4096 x 4096 C3D through the existing asynchronous recipe-source route: pass, 85 dispatcher ticks during load, final progress 100%, load state cleared, and exact target path bound as current source without automatic inspection execution.

Actual Release EXE GLB, STL, LAS, and LAZ reports each pass successful Viewer-only load, preserve recipe source/step count/dirty state, record no Preview/Publish/Run, and retain the last successful Viewer source after both a corrupt same-extension load and cancellation.
Current focused verification passes source-channel/decoder cancellation 39/39, Import-surface ViewModel routing/state 8/8, and Shell smoke command-line routing 46/46.

The full Release solution builds with 0 warnings and 0 errors; code-structure verification passes 68/68; the vendored Vision SDK package identity/hash/source-commit check passes; git diff --check reports no whitespace errors.

events.summary: Resolved after all six criteria received current focused, actual EXE, UI, and repository-gate evidence.
